The alloys with a nominal composition of Co 35Cr25Fe37.5Ni2.5 (at.%) were produced by a vacuum arc melting furnace with a water-cooled copper mold using pure metals (purity higher than 99.9 wt%). Melting was performed under a high-purity argon atmosphere. The ingots were re-melted at least five times to improve chemical homogeneity.
The obtained button ingots were homogenized at 1200 °C for 5 h followed by water-quenching.
Then, the samples were cold rolled to a thickness reduction ratio of 65%.

Subsequently, the rolled sheets were annealed at different temperatures (from 600 °C to 900 °C) for 60 min, respectively, followed by water-quenching or liquid nitrogen quenching. The samples were kept at cooling mediums for 10 min.
